column3: MT 61:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. The Hebrew title has “of David”; NASB adds “A Psalm” and sets the title in braces before verse 1.
Close to the Hebrew; “You will lead me” is rendered as an imperative, “Lead me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “let me sojourn” is rendered “Let me dwell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the possession” is rendered “the inheritance,” and NASB supplies “me.”
“You will add days to the days of the king” is rendered “You will prolong the king's life”; “like generation and generation” is rendered “as many generations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “may he sit” is rendered “He will abide,” and “faithfulness” as “truth.”
